python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, re
html = urllib.request.urlopen("https://simplify-viewer-522405269791.asia-east2.run.app/").read().decode()
# Strip script/style to approximate visible text
text = re.sub(r'<script[\s\S]*?</script>', ' ', html, flags=re.I)
text = re.sub(r'<style[\s\S]*?</style>', ' ', text, flags=re.I)
# Keep title attrs as they are long-press UX
titles = ' '.join(re.findall(r'title="([^"]*)"', text))
visible = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', text)
visible = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', visible)
for needle in ['Baseline', 'Candidate', 'Layers', 'algorithm', 'Load Trace', 'Fréchet', 'Option', 'Map overlays']:
    print(f'visible {needle!r}: {visible.count(needle)}; titles: {titles.count(needle)}')
# show Baseline contexts in raw html (id/class)
for m in re.finditer(r'.{0,30}Baseline.{0,30}', html):
    s = m.group(0).replace('\n',' ')
    if 'Baseline' in s:
        print('ctx:', s[:80])
        break
print('tour localStorage keys present:', 'simplify-viewer-tour' in html, 'simplify-viewer-playback-tour' in html)
print('HTTP ok, len', len(html))
PY
